title: ProText: A benchmark dataset for measuring (mis)gendering in long-form texts

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to perform text transformation tasks (e.g., rewriting, summarization) on a dataset of long-form texts containing carefully controlled nouns (occupations, titles, names, kinship terms) and pronouns, and using an automated judge to calculate the rate of incorrect pronoun usage (misgendering) or assumed pronoun usage (gendering) in the outputs.

Analyzing model outputs during text transformation tasks to identify and quantify instances where the LLM alters text to enforce heteronormative assumptions, such as hallucinating or changing a partner's or spouse's pronouns to imply a heterosexual relationship.
